results.title: The Odyssey: The Real Story
results.overview: After the fall of Troy, warrior-king Odysseus begins a perilous voyage home, only to be thrown into a decade of wandering across a world ruled by gods and monsters. He outwits cyclopes, resists enchantresses, and descends into the realm of the dead, while his family fights to survive in his absence.

results.title: Letter
results.overview: A young surgeon accompanies a group of communists from the Chechen-Ingush Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic secretly carrying a letter to L.I. Brezhnev in 1972. The story, which changed the fate of a nation, is based on true events.

results.title: Buttons
results.overview: Charlie, an eight year old boy, runs away from home into the nearby woods and discovers that his stuffed teddy bear, Buttons, has come to life.

results.title: Shocktopus
results.overview: An alien amoeba crashes to Earth and mutates aquatic life along the shores of North Carolina, unleashing an electrified octopus that terrorizes a seaside resort. Two special operatives try to stop the shock wave of cosmic carnage.

results.title: NJPW Road to Sakura Genesis 2026 - Day 5
results.original_title: NJPW Road to Sakura Genesis 2026 - Day 5
results.overview: The fifth and final night of Road to Sakura Genesis 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on April 2, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. The show featured a match for the IWGP Junior Heavyweight Tag Team Titles and was headlined by Douki (c) vs. YOH for the IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship.

results.title: Dead Hungry
results.overview: A grumpy shut-in's third eye accidentally opens after eating an offering meant for a charming but lonely ghost. Now bound together, they discover family secrets, shared heartaches, and a love that blurs the line between life and the afterlife.

results.title: Still Hope
results.overview: Beloved by her family and raised in a quiet community, 16-year-old Hope finds herself in danger when a new friend is not who he claims to be… Ripped from all she knows and forced into sex trafficking, Hope is stripped of her identity and threatened into submission, surviving years of abuse. Hope finally finds freedom and reunites with the family that never gave up looking for her. Though now safe, she struggles adjusting to her old life as she reconciles with all she’s endured. Hope’s journey is inspired by true stories and powerfully illustrates the courage it takes to find healing after life’s darkest moments.

results.title: We are all Young Gods
results.overview: December 2025: The Young Gods ignite the stage at Fri-Son. More than a concert, this visual experience captures the urgency of the live show while summoning the band's history. An organic celebration of a forty-year career, deeply rooted in Switzerland's most iconic rock venue.

results.title: Gallega invernal
results.overview: When a woman loves a bakery.

results.title: NJPW Death Vegas Invitational
results.overview: NJPW Death Vegas Invitational was a professional wrestling pay-per-view promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) and produced by El Desperado that took place on April 16, 2026 at the Horseshoe Las Vegas in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA.

results.title: The Doll
results.overview: Eastern France, nowadays.  Rémi, who has never recovered from a heartbreak, shares his life with a doll called Audrey. But the day his new coworker, Patricia, arrives at his company, Audrey comes to life. The two women will turn Rémi’s life upside down.

results.title: Battle
results.overview: Born mute until the age of ten, a boy rises to fame as a celebrated Rap singer, but the trials of love, fame, and social conflict lead him into turmoil and push him to the edge, until he discovers the true soul and purpose of his art.

results.title: Grizzly Attack
results.overview: Stranded at a remote cabin, a grieving family faces a relentless bear that tests their shelter and forces a final stand.

results.title: GCW: One Night Only 2026 (Philadelphia)
results.overview: GCW returns to its heartland for a massive event in Philadelphia.  Streaming Live on TrillerTV+, witness the return of the King and a collision of pure power that will shake the foundations of Philly wrestling.  Philadelphia has always been the epicenter of extreme, and for One Night Only, GCW is bringing a card that honors that legacy while pushing the boundaries of modern independent wrestling.

results.title: An Encounter
results.overview: Desiring intimacy one Friday night, Eli rollerblades away from his friends to have sex for the first time with an older man he met online.

results.title: Ray O'Leary Laughter? I Hardly Know Her!
results.original_title: Ray O'Leary Laughter? I Hardly Know Her!
results.overview: Ray O’Leary pulled a man from a wrecked car and as the man lay dying, he used his last ounce of strength to ask Ray to tell his children that he loved them. And Ray will get round to it but first he has to do this comedy show.

results.title: Synthetic
results.overview: The film is based on real-life events. Alena, a voice-over star, suddenly discovers that her voice has been stolen by the developers a major bank's neural network. Now her voice can be heard everywhere—from airport announcements to entertainment and gaming platforms. Alena realizes that in the modern reality a person's voice does not fall under legal protection. Thus, not only voice-over actors but everyone is at risk. The actress starts a struggle for the right to her own voice.

results.title: Evil Genius
results.overview: Follows the true story of the 2003 death of Brian Wells, a notorious case known as the “collar bomb” or “pizza bomber” incident. The FBI investigation revealed an extraordinarily complex and bizarre plot, later described as one of the most intricate crimes in the Bureau’s history.

results.title: Stardom 15th Anniversary Supreme Fight 2026 in Osaka
results.original_title: Stardom 15th Anniversary Supreme Fight 2026 in Osaka
results.overview: Supreme Fight 2026 in Osaka was a professional wrestling event produced by World Wonder Ring Stardom that took place on February 7, 2026, at EDION Arena Osaka in Osaka, Japan. The show was headlined by Saya Kamitani (c) vs. Starlight Kid for the World of Stardom Championship.

results.title: Ajosepo 2: The Gathering
results.overview: Two families reunite for a lavish Yoruba wedding after a past scandal nearly tore them apart. As Mary and Jide prepare to marry, unresolved tensions, family pressure, and reputation fears threaten their union. Meanwhile, new parents Dapo and Tani battle constant clashes between their feuding mothers. Amid tradition, church politics, and romantic distractions, both couples must choose honesty and commitment before the celebration unravels.
